title: Certify and exhaust the prime61 horizontal class with a bounded-memory walker
status_note: Disk-backed implementation and Drive restore controls pass; the 250-curve pilot removes the retained-vector requirement. Full class/degree-set coverage, all-class workloads and a sized disk/compute envelope remain open.
question: What are the factor-base results over every base-field isomorphism class in the fixed ordinary prime61 trace class?
decision_value: Discharges the full-horizontal-class interpretation of the user's request. The degree-61 one-hop panel is complete within its bound but cannot establish a class-wide ranking. A verified resumable traversal would retain every cap and failure rather than infer the unseen results.

resources.notes: Pilot envelope only. SQLite cache is bounded; full-class disk, CPU and runtime sizing remain unknown. Drive checkpoint upload/download/resume is verified for small archives, not full quota. Freeze a complete envelope before readiness; no remote compute is provisioned.

outputs.result_schema: isogeny-disk-status/v1 plus SQLite snapshot; full coverage certificate and protocol still required
